clue.text: A guitar in care of a singer, formerly

indicators.note: the guitar phrase sits inside the abbreviation, so 'in' signals one piece placed within another

parts.note: c/o, CO, is the postal abbreviation for care of
a Strat is a Fender Stratocaster guitar

explanation.surface: A guitar is left in someone's care by a singer of years gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: A castrated male soprano was a kind of singer common in earlier centuries, hence 'formerly'.

clue.text: Show by topless couple

parts.note: a couple is a pair

explanation.definitionFit: To air something is to show or broadcast it, as in airing a programme or one's views.

clue.text: Message to go in the Times

indicators.note: the word for going sits inside the pair of times, so 'in' signals placing within

parts.note: T stands for time, so times plural gives two of them, TT

explanation.surface: A message heading off to appear in The Times newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Times' looks like the newspaper, but it supplies two T's, one for each time.
explanation.definitionFit: A post on Twitter is a short online message.

clue.text: Act with choir performing about half of Maya lacking colour

explanation.surface: A choir and some actors stage a show about Maya, perhaps in black and white.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' rearranges ACT CHOIR into ACHROTIC, which goes 'about' MA, the first half of Maya.
explanation.definitionFit: Achromatic is the technical term for something without hue, such as grey, white or black.

clue.text: One of the Ducks on a Pond's residents, stupid!

fish live in a pond

explanation.surface: An exclamation calling a duck in a pond stupid.
explanation.walkthrough: The ducks look like pond birds, but a duck is a cricketer's score of zero, giving O.
explanation.definitionFit: Oafish behaviour is clumsy and dim-witted, so stupid fits the adjective.

clue.text: Boxer has to tease U3A, if missing tweet here

clue.text: Tasks for an entrepreneur

definitions.meaning: pieces of work to be done

explanation.surface: Duties set aside for a business person.
explanation.definitionFit: Jobs are tasks, and Steve Jobs was the Apple businessman.

clue.text: Broke some wind in this hat?

parts.note: stove is the past tense of stave, as in stove in, broke
a pipe is a wind instrument

explanation.surface: Did someone pass wind into this hat?
explanation.walkthrough: The flatulent surface is a red herring: wind means a wind instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A stovepipe is a tall cylindrical hat of the kind Abraham Lincoln wore.

clue.text: Acted with restraint in drama externally controlled by journalist

indicators.note: the controlling words wrap around the drama from outside, which is what externally signals

parts.note: under means controlled by, as in under someone's command
ED, editor, is the usual crossword journalist
a play is a drama

explanation.surface: A restrained performance in a play run by a journalist.
explanation.definitionFit: To underplay a role is to perform it with understatement, holding back.

clue.text: Bottom part of tree contains third of bark

indicators.note: the third letter of the word bark is taken

explanation.definitionFit: A breech is the buttocks, or the rear part of a gun barrel.

clue.text: Lies about a retired Christian's benign tumours

indicators.note: the word for lies wraps around the designer's name

parts.note: fibs are small lies

parts.note: Christian Dior, the French fashion designer

explanation.walkthrough: Christian is not a believer here but the fashion designer Christian Dior; 'retired' reads his name backwards, and 'a' is only a link word.

clue.text: Going round the US Open in top place

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are spun into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'Going round' rearranges THE US OPEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A penthouse is the luxurious flat on a building's highest floor.

clue.text: No time for drink later, playing a sort of triangle

explanation.definitionFit: An equilateral triangle has all three sides equal in length.

clue.text: Regular provider of the fairest rents

indicators.note: regular letters, every other one, are supplied by the phrase

explanation.surface: A landlord who regularly offers the fairest rents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rents' looks like a noun for payments, but means rips.
explanation.definitionFit: Rents are tears, splits in fabric.

clue.text: Kind of idea that's almost satisfied

parts.note: a thought is an idea

indicators.note: the word for satisfied loses its final letter, coming up just short

parts.note: full means satisfied after a meal

explanation.surface: A type of idea that is nearly satisfying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind of idea' reads as one phrase, but 'Kind' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoughtful person is considerate, so kind is a synonym.

clue.text: Content to out a handsome statesman

explanation.surface: A statesman is happy to expose a good-looking rival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Content' looks like happy, but means contents.

clue.text: People like 6 down using iMacs near Barking

indicators.note: barking means mad, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: Users of iMacs near Barking, in London, are compared with Steve Jobs.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 down is JOBS, Steve Jobs of Apple, maker of iMacs; Barking is also a London district.
explanation.definitionFit: Steve Jobs was an American, so citizens of the USA are people like him.

clue.text: Delight in short time visiting farm

indicators.note: the brief time goes inside the farm word as a visitor would

parts.note: to till is to farm the soil
HR is the short form of hour

explanation.surface: Enjoying a quick visit to a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrill is a sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure.

clue.text: Doctor eligible, but wanting the French or the Spanish chemist

explanation.surface: An eligible doctor who is neither French nor Spanish: a chemist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' rearranges ELIGIBLE less LE (or EL): EIGIBL becomes the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Justus von Liebig was a 19th-century German chemist, a founder of organic chemistry.

clue.text: Expression of disgust, cycling round city? Very much so

explanation.surface: Ugh at cycling around a city? Yes indeed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycling round' moves the last letter of the exclamation to its front, rather than meaning a bike ride; 'so' is only a link word.

clue.text: Puppies? Small, not large, right?

explanation.walkthrough: 'not large' removes the second L of LITTLE, leaving LITTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter is a set of young born at once to a dog; the question mark marks the example.

clue.text: Reportedly remained sober

parts.note: stayed means remained

explanation.surface: It's said someone kept off the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid means sedate and serious, which is sober in manner.

clue.text: Superior getting drunk with Mark

parts.note: high means intoxicated
a grade is a mark given for work

explanation.surface: Someone feels superior after getting drunk with a friend called Mark.
explanation.definitionFit: High-grade means of top quality, so superior in standard.

clue.text: Indian food in fresh 2 gets cheers

clue.text: Gathering around an interest in The Iron Stone

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
st is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight

explanation.surface: A meeting of enthusiasts at a place called The Iron Stone.
explanation.definitionFit: A fest is a festival or get-together for fans of one thing, like a film fest.

clue.text: Best get 13 flowing? Best for old Man U fans, perhaps

definitions.text: Best for old Man U fans, perhaps
definitions.meaning: George Best, the Manchester United footballer whom many fans rank the finest ever

indicators.note: flowing means moving freely, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 13 across

clue.text: Follower of Fox News frustrated initially with dire output

indicators.note: frustrated plans are upset, so the letters are disturbed
the pool of letters is put out in a new form
the first letters of Fox and News are taken

explanation.walkthrough: The initials F and N join DIRE and are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: On social media a friend is someone who follows your posts, a supporter.

clue.text: Fanny Adams finds Puck in Log Cabin extremely elevated

the setter goes within the outer letters
the extreme letters, first and last, of the phrase are used

clue.text: Caterpillar leaves one some essential teachings, originally concealed

indicators.note: originally means at the beginning, so each word gives its opening letter

explanation.definitionFit: A closet supporter is a secret one, hidden from public view.

clue.text: Beer all drunk around lunchtime? That's predictable

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go round the time

parts.note: one o'clock, written as Roman numeral I

explanation.walkthrough: Lunchtime stands for one o'clock, so it gives I, the Roman numeral for one.
